capabilities: Render clip cards for highlights, pages, videos, tweets, PDF excerpts, and images in Reading view
Browse, filter, and sort all saved clips in a Clip Manager panel
Edit clip tags, notes, and content type with changes written back to source files
Delete clips from the Clip Manager or clip cards
Migrate clips saved in the old format to the current callout structure
disambiguation: Despite the name, the plugin does not capture web content itself; it only handles the Obsidian side of clips saved by the Chrome extension.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README states the plugin makes no network requests and has no telemetry.
problem: Clips saved by the QuickClip Capture extension land in the vault as raw files, with no polished rendering or central way to browse and edit them.

relations.evidence: Renders and manages clips saved by the QuickClip Capture Chrome extension

summary: Companion to the QuickClip Capture Chrome extension that renders saved clips as cards in Reading view and manages them in a Clip Manager panel.
